title: Legal ontology
description: Portable legal semantics imported from the Lattice industry ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: legal
  title: Legal Ontology
  description: Shared agreement, party, matter, filing, regulatory, and statement-of-work semantics.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: legal-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:4ef4fd96a56fa6717e72de9f1d25668c6a0676a469635143f9776735b2422392
spec:
  types:
    - id: legal_party
      label: Legal Party
      description: A person or organization participating in a legal obligation or matter.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: legal_party.submitting_entity_name
          label: Submitting Entity Name
          description: Full legal name of the entity filing the submission
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: legal_party.law_firm
          label: Law Firm
          description: Name of the law firm representing the filing party (null if in-house or pro se)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: legal_party.attorney_email
          label: Attorney Email
          description: Email address of the filing attorney (null if not provided)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
        - id: legal_party.attorney_name
          label: Attorney Name
          description: Full name of the attorney signing or filing the document
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/3
        - id: legal_party.client_contact
          label: Client Contact
          description: Name of the primary client contact person (project manager, sponsor, or signatory)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/4
        - id: legal_party.client_name
          label: Client Name
          description: Full legal name of the client organization
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/5
        - id: legal_party.client_po_number
          label: Client Po Number
          description: Client's Purchase Order number referenced in the SOW (null if not present)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/6
        - id: legal_party.client_role
          label: Client Role
          description: Plaintiff, defendant, third party, creditor, debtor, witness, or other.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/7
        - id: legal_party.defendant_name
          label: Defendant Name
          description: Full name of the defendant(s); if multiple, concatenate with "; " separator
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/8
        - id: legal_party.defendant_names
          label: Defendant Names
          description: Defendants, respondents, or opposing parties.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/9
        - id: legal_party.filing_party
          label: Filing Party
          description: "Which party filed this document. One of: Plaintiff | Defendant | Third_Party | Court | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/10
        - id: legal_party.party_1_name
          label: Party 1 Name
          description: Full legal name of the first party
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/11
        - id: legal_party.party_1_role
          label: Party 1 Role
          description: "Role of the first party. One of: Disclosing | Receiving | Both (for mutual agreements)"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/12
        - id: legal_party.party_1_state
          label: Party 1 State
          description: State or jurisdiction of incorporation/organization for party 1 (two-letter state code or country
            if non-US)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/13
        - id: legal_party.party_2_name
          label: Party 2 Name
          description: Full legal name of the second party
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/14
        - id: legal_party.party_2_role
          label: Party 2 Role
          description: "Role of the second party. One of: Disclosing | Receiving | Both"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/15
        - id: legal_party.party_2_state
          label: Party 2 State
          description: State or jurisdiction of incorporation/organization for party 2
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/16
        - id: legal_party.plaintiff_name
          label: Plaintiff Name
          description: Full name of the plaintiff(s); if multiple, concatenate with "; " separator
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/17
        - id: legal_party.plaintiff_names
          label: Plaintiff Names
          description: Plaintiffs, claimants, or petitioners.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/18
        - id: legal_party.submitting_entity_id
          label: Submitting Entity Id
          description: The primary regulatory identifier for the submitting entity. This may be a CIK (SEC), LEI, EIN,
            FDA Establishment Identifier, or other ID
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/19
        - id: legal_party.vendor_contact
          label: Vendor Contact
          description: Name of the primary vendor contact person (project manager or account manager)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/20
        - id: legal_party.vendor_name
          label: Vendor Name
          description: Full legal name of the vendor / service provider organization
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/21
    - id: agreement
      label: Agreement
      description: A governed legal agreement and its operative terms.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: agreement.effective_date
          label: Effective Date
          description: The date the agreement becomes effective, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: agreement.amendment_number
          label: Amendment Number
          description: If this document is an amendment or addendum, the amendment number as integer (e.g., 1 for
            "Amendment No. 1"; null if original agreement)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: agreement.governing_law
          label: Governing Law
          description: The state or jurisdiction whose laws govern the agreement (e.g., "CA", "NY", "DE", "England and
            Wales")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
        - id: agreement.agreement_type
          label: Agreement Type
          description: "Classification of the agreement. One of: NDA | MSA | MNDA | MOU | LOI | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/3
        - id: agreement.arbitration_clause
          label: Arbitration Clause
          description: Boolean — true if the agreement requires disputes to be resolved by arbitration
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/4
        - id: agreement.arbitration_venue
          label: Arbitration Venue
          description: City and/or state where arbitration proceedings would be held (null if no arbitration clause)
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/5
        - id: agreement.confidentiality_period_years
          label: Confidentiality Period Years
          description: Duration of the confidentiality obligation in years as decimal (null if perpetual or not
            explicitly stated in years)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/6
        - id: agreement.confidentiality_request
          label: Confidentiality Request
          description: Boolean — true if the submitting entity has requested confidential treatment of all or part of
            the submission
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/7
        - id: agreement.confidentiality_scope
          label: Confidentiality Scope
          description: Brief description of what information is deemed confidential (up to 200 chars)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/8
        - id: agreement.expiration_date
          label: Expiration Date
          description: The date the agreement expires or terminates, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if perpetual or not stated)
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/9
        - id: agreement.renewal_notice_days
          label: Renewal Notice Days
          description: Number of days' advance notice required to prevent auto-renewal, as integer (null if not
            applicable)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/10
        - id: agreement.return_or_destroy_obligation
          label: Return Or Destroy Obligation
          description: Boolean — true if the agreement requires return or destruction of confidential materials upon
            termination or request
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/11
    - id: legal_matter
      label: Legal Matter
      description: A governed dispute, case, or legal engagement.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: legal_matter.case_status
          label: Case Status
          description: Open, stayed, settled, judgment, closed, appealed, or other.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: legal_matter.case_name
          label: Case Name
          description: The case caption name (e.g., "Apex Corp. v. Meridian Technologies, Inc.")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: legal_matter.case_number
          label: Case Number
          description: The official docket or case number assigned by the court (e.g., "1:25-cv-04812-LTS", "Case No.
            BC712345")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: legal_matter.case_type
          label: Case Type
          description: Commercial, employment, collections, bankruptcy, class action, arbitration, or other.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: legal_matter.discovery_status
          label: Discovery Status
          description: Discovery phase or status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: legal_matter.exposure_amount
          label: Exposure Amount
          description: Claimed damages, reserve, or exposure amount.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
        - id: legal_matter.matter_id
          label: Matter Id
          description: Internal matter or case file identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/6
        - id: legal_matter.settlement_status
          label: Settlement Status
          description: Settlement posture or demand status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/7
    - id: court_filing
      label: Court Filing
      description: A document formally submitted in a court proceeding.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: court_filing.court_name
          label: Court Name
          description: Full official name of the court (e.g., "United States District Court for the Southern District of
            New York", "Superior Court of the State of California, County of Los Angeles")
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: court_filing.filing_date
          label: Filing Date
          description: Date the document was filed with the court, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: court_filing.court_level
          label: Court Level
          description: "The level of the court. One of: Federal | State | Appellate | Administrative | Tribal | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: court_filing.filing_party
          label: Filing Party
          description: "Which party filed this document. One of: Plaintiff | Defendant | Third_Party | Court | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
        - id: court_filing.filing_period_from
          label: Filing Period From
          description: Start date of the filing period (e.g., fiscal year start for 10-K, quarter start for 10-Q),
            format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/4
        - id: court_filing.filing_period_to
          label: Filing Period To
          description: End date of the filing period (e.g., fiscal year end for 10-K), format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/5
        - id: court_filing.filing_type
          label: Filing Type
          description: "The type of court document. One of: Complaint | Answer | Motion | Brief | Opposition | Reply |
            Order | Judgment | Stipulation | Subpoena | Notice | Declaration | Deposition | Petition | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/6
        - id: court_filing.hearing_date
          label: Hearing Date
          description: Date of any associated hearing, trial, or oral argument, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not scheduled
            or not stated)
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/7
        - id: court_filing.hearing_dates
          label: Hearing Dates
          description: Upcoming hearing, mediation, trial, or conference dates.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/8
        - id: court_filing.judge_name
          label: Judge Name
          description: Name of the presiding judge or magistrate (null if not yet assigned or not stated)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/9
        - id: court_filing.jury_demand
          label: Jury Demand
          description: Boolean — true if the filing includes a demand for trial by jury
          dataType: boolean
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/10
        - id: court_filing.pages
          label: Pages
          description: Total number of pages in the filed document as integer (null if not stated)
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/11
        - id: court_filing.relief_requested
          label: Relief Requested
          description: Summary of the relief sought in this filing (up to 300 chars)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/12
    - id: regulatory_submission
      label: Regulatory Submission
      description: A governed submission to a regulator and its disposition.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: regulatory_submission.submission_type
          label: Submission Type
          description: "The specific type of regulatory submission. Examples:"
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: regulatory_submission.acceptance_criteria_described
          label: Acceptance Criteria Described
          description: Boolean — true if the SOW contains defined acceptance criteria for deliverables
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: regulatory_submission.acceptance_date
          label: Acceptance Date
          description: Date the regulator formally accepted the submission for review, format YYYY-MM-DD (null if not
            stated)
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: regulatory_submission.material_change_described
          label: Material Change Described
          description: Boolean — true if the submission discloses or describes a material change, event, or condition
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: regulatory_submission.regulator
          label: Regulator
          description: "The regulatory body receiving the submission. One of: FDA | SEC | FinCEN | CFTC | FINRA | FTC |
            CFPB | State | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: regulatory_submission.review_division
          label: Review Division
          description: The specific division, branch, or office within the regulator that reviews this submission (null
            if not applicable or not stated)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
        - id: regulatory_submission.subject_of_submission
          label: Subject Of Submission
          description: Brief description of the subject matter of the filing (up to 300 chars)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/6
        - id: regulatory_submission.submission_date
          label: Submission Date
          description: Date the submission was filed or submitted, format YYYY-MM-DD
          dataType: date
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/7
        - id: regulatory_submission.submission_id
          label: Submission Id
          description: The unique identifier assigned to the submission. This may be a docket number (FDA), accession
            number (SEC EDGAR), CTR/SAR reference number (FinCEN), or other regulatory reference ID
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/8
        - id: regulatory_submission.submission_status
          label: Submission Status
          description: "Current status of the submission. One of: Accepted | Under_Review | Approved | Refused |
            Withdrawn | Pending | Deficient | null"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/9
    - id: statement_of_work
      label: Statement of Work
      description: A governed definition of project scope, deliverables, price, and acceptance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: statement_of_work.acceptance_criteria_described
          label: Acceptance Criteria Described
          description: Boolean — true if the SOW contains defined acceptance criteria for deliverables
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: statement_of_work.change_order_process_described
          label: Change Order Process Described
          description: Boolean — true if the SOW describes a change order or change control process
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: statement_of_work.ip_ownership
          label: Ip Ownership
          description: "Who owns intellectual property created under this SOW. One of: Client | Vendor | Joint | null"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: statement_of_work.payment_schedule
          label: Payment Schedule
          description: Description of the payment schedule or milestones for billing (up to 200 chars)
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: statement_of_work.pricing_model
          label: Pricing Model
          description: "The pricing structure. One of: Fixed | T&M | Retainer | Milestone | Other"
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: statement_of_work.project_description
          label: Project Description
          description: Brief description of the project or engagement scope (up to 300 characters)
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
        - id: statement_of_work.sow_number
          label: Sow Number
          description: 'The unique SOW identifier or reference number (e.g., "SOW-2025-007", "SOW #3")'
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/6
        - id: statement_of_work.sow_title
          label: Sow Title
          description: Descriptive title of the statement of work
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/7
        - id: statement_of_work.total_contract_value
          label: Total Contract Value
          description: Total value of the SOW as decimal (null if T&M with no cap, or retainer with no stated total)
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/8
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
